ImageDescription: World War I poster. "Remember Belgium--Buy bonds--Fourth Liberty Loan" - During World War I, Allied Nations relied for propaganda on images and accounts of German atrocities to motivate their citizens to participate in the war effort. In this scene, the silhouetted German soldier with his thick Kaiser mustache drags a young girl away while the ruins of the city burn in the background
